title: Quick Query and file saving fixes
summary: Quick Query is easier to scroll and save from, with smoother Oracle imports and HTML file saving.
notes: Quick Query editors keep scrolling inside the editor.
Oracle import remembers your draft query between visits.
Quick Query Save As has clearer file naming and a separate .sql extension.
HTML Template can save the current document as an HTML file.
Base64 Tools can preview decoded files before saving them.
Dashboard Overview now applies the selected time range to its metrics.
